title: Security requirements prioritization ladder and intake flow for enterprise asks
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Problem: Sales, support, and CSMs send varied security & compliance asks (SOC2 control clarifications, ISO evidence, HIPAA onboarding requirements, GDPR dataflow questions, DPAs and third-party questionnaires). Currently routing is ad hoc, response SLAs vary, and engineering/legal effort spikes unpredictably. Goal: a reproducible intake + prioritization ladder that routes asks to the right owner, sets clear SLAs, and provides predictable resourcing and messaging to customers. This ticket defines the intake form, scoring rubric, routing rules, owner matrix, and sample templated responses for common ask classes.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical intake form published and embedded in Sales/CS playbook
A 5-point prioritization rubric implemented and documented with examples for SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, and vendor questionnaires
Routing rules with owners (Security, Legal, Product, Engineering, Support) and SLA tiers defined
Automation mapping in Zendesk/Linear: label mapping + auto-assign rules tested
Two sample completed runbooks: (1) SOC2 evidence request, (2) Standard vendor questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ)
decision_log: 2025-02-15: Decided to score asks by three primary axes (contractual/regulatory obligation, security risk, implementation effort) to avoid one-dimensional prioritization - agreed by Legal + Security
2025-02-18: Agreed to use 5-day SLA for P0/P1 enterprise contractual obligations; 14-day SLA for low-risk clarifications
2025-02-21: Chosen owners: Security for technical answers, Legal for contractual language, Product for product behavior clarifications, Support for non-technical intake follow-ups
next_steps: Finalize Google Form + embedded intake link and publish in Sales Confluence (owner: Connor)
Create Zendesk trigger and Linear automation to apply 'security-intake' label and route to PM triage queue (owner: Support Ops)
Run two pilot requests with top 3 enterprise customers to validate scoring and SLAs (owner: Aisha)
Produce templated language for each ask class and store in Drive (owner: Legal)
Add training to AE/CS weekly for intake + expected SLAs (owner: RevOps)

example_rubric: Score components: ContractualObligation (0-5), RegulatorySeverity (0-5), SecurityRisk (0-5), CustomerTier (0-5), ImplementationEffort (0-5)
Routing thresholds: Total >=4.0 => P0 escalate to Exec + 5-day SLA; 3.0-3.99 => P1 Security+Legal action 5-7 days; 2.0-2.99 => P2 Product answer 14 days; <2.0 => P3 Support response 30 days
Examples: SOC2 control failure claim => ContractualObligation=5, RegulatorySeverity=4, SecurityRisk=5 => Total ~4.6 => P0
SIG/CAIQ baseline questionnaire from small prospect => ContractualObligation=1, RegulatorySeverity=1, SecurityRisk=1, CustomerTier=1, ImplementationEffort=2 => Total <2 => P3
